name: Gaussian Splatting Initialization and Parameterization
definition: Initializes a set of 3D Gaussians from COLMAP point cloud data (xyz, rgb) by creating learnable parameters for position, features, scaling, rotation, and opacity.
summary: Gaussian Splatting Initialization and Parameterization constructs 3D Gaussian primitives from sparse Structure from Motion point clouds, providing geometrically plausible starting positions and attributes to avoid the poor convergence and artifacts of random initialization.
